sourceEvidence.result: Every valid call reloads six candidate artifacts and eight originals. Legacy manifest fixed SHA check remains; the other five candidate files keep explicit byte-length/SHA checks. Eight originals retain explicit length/SHA checks. Fixed publication/admission/pending, source/row/reading/license/authority and selected-definition validation stays on every call.

New module-private single-slot cache key is algorithm version plus actual just-read-and-verified gzip length and digest. Only rows/title lookup are retained. No Buffer, capsule/DTO, auth verdict, rootDecision or customer/session data is stored. Directory parameters must be primitive strings before path handling. No caller digest/rows/capsule can call the private cache constructor.

Unchanged M475 helper verifies its fixed gzip SHA, parses in private trusted realm, deep-freezes every canonical JSON node and records only canonical rows in a private WeakMap. Title records/index facade are frozen and backing Map remains private. Caller/fake-frozen/proxy arrays get uncached fallback lookups, not canonical index identity. Helper has one fixed-source slot; new cache has one slot, so retained source derivation count is bounded.

Unicode proof now reuses originalHashes computed from the same just-read verified bytes used to construct the line arrays. Neither map/Buffer escapes. Proof shape, digest equality, exact line, two-way Unicode relation and own-entry retention checks remain. Title membership lookup is equivalent to the former raw.some equality check; selected entries still use original array indices and exact full-entry/heteronym/definition equality.

No candidate authority, whole-name/score grant, original pending review, parsed-entry hash, reading/tone, selected definition or license check is deleted. Return capsule/verification is rebuilt per call and remains outside persistent cache. Pins and trusted helper are reused byte-identically; no source pin or publication data is changed.
